citations.quote: The current Australian passport was sighted and the applicant's Darwin residence was confirmed from the accommodation record.

facts.claim: Intake staff sighted the applicant's current Australian passport in person.

citations.quote: No document number was copied into this note or the application bundle.
The identity document was sighted, not retained

facts.claim: No passport number or copy was kept on file, so the citizenship evidence rests on the intake worker's note.

citations.quote: I do not own or partly own residential property in Australia.

facts.claim: The applicant declares that she does not own or partly own residential property in Australia.
Apart from her own declaration, the file has no independent check of property ownership, such as a title search.

citations.quote: I have no land, business interest, farm or investment property.

facts.claim: The policy's domestic or family violence exemption is not needed, because no property interest is declared.

citations.quote: My present casual shifts vary and I have not enclosed a current earnings statement.
I will request a current earnings statement and provide it when received.

facts.claim: The applicant has not enclosed a current earnings statement for her present casual work.

citations.quote: Pay period: 21 February to 27 February 2026.
Elena Verran's casual employment with Quayline Events ended on 17 July 2026.

facts.claim: The only payslip in the file is out of date: it covers a week in February 2026 from an employer whose engagement ended on 17 July 2026.

citations.quote: Gross pay for this week: $492.00.

facts.claim: That old payslip shows gross pay of $492.00 for one week, so it does not reflect current income.

citations.quote: She had completed two casual shifts with a new venue coordinator, but could not yet predict the next roster.

facts.claim: The applicant has worked two casual shifts with a new venue coordinator, but there is no pay record for that work.

citations.quote: I can provide an account statement if one is required to complete the assessment.

facts.claim: The file has no bank or transaction account statement for her assets, although she offered to provide one.
The Income and Assets policy that sets the urban income thresholds is not in the file, so the thresholds cannot be tested.

citations.quote: Balance owing at close: $865.40.

facts.claim: The applicant owes a former social housing provider, Marigold Housing Cooperative, a closing balance of $865.40.

citations.quote: Cleaning charge entered after the exit inspection: $615.40.
The cleaning charge remains under review following Elena's request for the inspection photographs and itemised contractor account.

facts.claim: She disputes the $615.40 cleaning charge, and that charge is still under review.

citations.quote: Recovery of debt owed to other social housing providers will be managed in line with the specific provider’s policies and may differ.

facts.claim: The policy says debts owed to other social housing providers are recovered under that provider's own policies, so the Marigold debt is not a debt to the CEO (Housing).

citations.quote: No other housing provider has sent me a debt notice.

facts.claim: The file does not show any debt owed to the CEO (Housing).

citations.quote: The cooperative has not arranged automatic deductions or referred the account to a collection agency.

facts.claim: Marigold has not sent the account to a collection agency or set up automatic deductions.

citations.quote: Previously held a social housing tenancy: No.
Property: social housing unit in Darwin, address withheld from this extract at the former tenant's request.
I previously held a tenancy with Marigold Housing Cooperative.

facts.claim: The application form says she has never held a social housing tenancy, which contradicts the Marigold records and her own declaration.

citations.quote: Tenancy commenced 4 March 2024 and ended 19 December 2025.

facts.claim: Her Marigold social housing tenancy ended on 19 December 2025, which is within the last 2 years.

citations.quote: End reason: agreed surrender of tenancy; no termination for breach was recorded.
The cooperative did not issue a termination notice or apply for an order ending the tenancy.

facts.claim: The Marigold tenancy ended by agreed surrender, with no termination for breach and no termination notice.

citations.quote: No breach finding was entered on the tenancy record.
The room inventory recorded ordinary wear to floor finishes and a cleaning item in the kitchen.

facts.claim: The exit inspection made no breach finding and found only a cleaning item and ordinary wear.

citations.quote: The inspection and ledger remain separate records because their review processes are still open.

facts.claim: Marigold's extract does not certify that the closing charges are agreed, and its inspection and ledger reviews are still open.

citations.quote: Previously applied for social housing: No.

facts.claim: The application form also says she never applied for social housing, which does not fit her having held a Marigold social housing tenancy.

citations.quote: Priority consideration requested: domestic or family violence and risk of homelessness.

facts.claim: She asks for priority on two grounds: domestic or family violence, and risk of homelessness.

citations.quote: Elena described intimidation and repeated uninvited visits by her former partner after separation.
including Jonah waiting near her workplace on two occasions

facts.claim: Larkhaven records her account of intimidation and repeated uninvited visits by her former partner after they separated.

citations.quote: I have not obtained a domestic violence order.
declined a police referral at that time

facts.claim: She has no domestic violence order and declined a police referral.

citations.quote: In our assessment, a settled address separate from the former partner is needed for Elena's safety and continuity of care.

facts.claim: Larkhaven assesses that she needs a settled address separate from her former partner for her safety.

citations.quote: The booked room is available through 9 October 2026 only; no extension is currently available.

facts.claim: Her temporary room runs only through 9 October 2026, and no extension is available.

citations.quote: we have no confirmed replacement room for her

facts.claim: Larkhaven has no replacement room confirmed for her after the booking ends.

citations.quote: Elena said her cousin could keep bags but could not house her.

facts.claim: Her cousin can store bags but cannot give her somewhere to stay overnight.

citations.quote: two private rental inspections did not lead to an application because the advertised rents exceeded the amount Elena could reliably pay

facts.claim: She could not afford the private rentals she looked at.

citations.quote: Elena attended a planned review for sleep disruption and anxiety symptoms following a recent change in living circumstances.
The clinic has not assessed a need for a modified dwelling or physical access features.

facts.claim: A clinic note records sleep disruption and anxiety and says stable housing would help her care, but it does not claim a serious medical problem or the need for a modified dwelling.

citations.quote: Issued by: Asha Fen, bookings manager, Tidebend Lodge.

facts.claim: An independent booking confirmation from the lodge documents the end of her temporary accommodation.

citations.quote: The record is for Larkhaven casework and contains the client's account as reported at intake.

facts.claim: The family violence evidence is the support service's record of what she reported, not an independent finding.

citations.quote: Declared by Elena Verran on 2 October 2026 before Talia Wren, authorised witness, Darwin.

facts.claim: She has made a statutory declaration about her circumstances before an authorised witness.
The Identification and Documentation policy, which lists the documents needed to prove urgent need, is not in the file.

citations.quote: although the CEO (Housing) has some discretion for extreme situations

facts.claim: The policy lets the CEO (Housing) use some discretion in extreme situations for priority applicants who do not meet eligibility.

citations.quote: Departure is due by the ordinary morning checkout time on 10 October.

facts.claim: The urgency is short-term because she must leave the lodge by the morning of 10 October.
The Discretionary Decision Making policy is not in the file, so the test for an extreme situation is not available.

citations.quote: No change has been made to the lease parties by this letter alone.

facts.claim: She may still be a party to the private shared lease with her former partner, because the lease parties have not been changed.

citations.quote: The applicant also showed the original short stay booking in her own name
The applicant is not named on the short stay room booking as a tenant

facts.claim: The verification note says the booking was in her own name, while the application says she is not named on the booking as a tenant.

citations.quote: Elena asks that no correspondence be sent to her former shared address.
I do not consent to my former partner being told the location of the room or my safe collection point for letters.

facts.claim: She asks that her location not be disclosed and that nothing be sent to the former shared address, which affects how the office contacts her.
